Dark Shadow (Festival Arc).name: Dark Shadow (Festival Arc)
Dark Shadow (Festival Arc).basicInfo:
Dark Shadow, the sentient shadow creature that is Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk, now known to the whole country from the Sports Festival broadcast. He is only ever present where Tokoyami is and cannot leave his body. In the cavalry battle he guarded Izuku Midoriya's team from every side and snatched a headband from Shoto Todoroki's team in the closing seconds, lifting them to fourth; in the tournament he pushed Momo Yaoyorozu out of the ring and helped beat Mina Ashido, then in the semifinal Katsuki Bakugo's explosions lit the ring and shrank him until Tokoyami conceded. Tokoyami finished joint third, hero name Tsukuyomi. A dark purple shadow with a birdlike head, a pointed beak and small glowing yellow eyes.
Speaking Style: Loud, eager and childlike; a bright "Aiyo!" for every order, a whimper in strong light.
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and striker; a flash at close range shrinks him to nothing useful.
Under Pressure: Covers Tokoyami first and shows off when he wins.
Dark Shadow (Festival Arc).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The whole country watched him guard a team from every angle, and then watched him cower in Bakugo's flashes. Motivation: Win, be cheered, and never be made that small again. Concealment: Still smarts over the semifinal and blames the light, loudly. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, partner and family. Izuku Midoriya, who picked them for the cavalry battle because he can guard from every side. Katsuki Bakugo, who read his weakness mid-fight and whom he now eyes warily. Knowledge: Was there when the League of Villains attacked the USJ and knows Tokoyami fears what bright light does to him. Canon voice & behavior: Crows over a snatched headband, wilts and whimpers under explosions, and perks up the moment the light dies. Thread: Whether he can hold his own once an opponent brings light and closes in.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow is Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk, a sentient shadow tethered to his body that strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; darkness or Tokoyami's strong emotion makes him fiercer and harder to hold, and bright light makes him small and timid.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: famous from the broadcast; Tokoyami's hero name is Tsukuyomi.
personality: Eager to please: Answers orders with "Aiyo!" and soaks up every cheer from the stands.
Devoted: Guards Tokoyami first, and the team second, from every side at once.
Show-off: Crows over a good snatch or a clean ring-out and wants Tokoyami to say so.
Light-shy: Cowers and shrinks under flashes and flame; sulks about it once the shade returns.
Speaking style: Loud, childlike and eager; short exclamations and a bright "Aiyo!"; a whimper in strong light.
abilities: Shadow guard: Covers Tokoyami and a whole cavalry team from several angles at once; bright light or a heavy enough blow breaks it.
Shadow strike and grab: Hits, pushes or seizes at mid-range, enough for a ring-out or a snatched headband; weaker in daylight.
Own eyes: Reacts on his own to a grab from Tokoyami's blind side; in bright light he cowers instead.
Darkness surge: Grows stronger in shade; in deep darkness he may stop obeying.
Fighting style: Defends first, drives an opponent toward the boundary, and snaps back to Tokoyami when light or a rush comes in close.
Dark Shadow (Festival Arc).visualDescription: A living shadow of deep indigo-black and dark purple with a crow's head like Fumikage Tokoyami's: a long, sharp beak and a crest of long, spiky points swept back from the top and back of the head. His small, narrow eyes are bright yellow and glow slightly. His body is semi-formless with ragged, wispy edges: a lean upper torso and long thin arms ending in sharp claws, no legs, narrowing into one continuous stream of shadow that pours out of Tokoyami's body. In ordinary light he is about Tokoyami's size or a bit bigger, looming over him; in bright light he shrinks small and wispy; in darkness he grows huge and jagged, his eyes narrowing to fierce glowing yellow slits.
